I'll take the CSE455 setup as Professor Alvarez: my calendar in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, TAs Sarah, John and Priya, the group thread, and the department office for official schedule and cancellations. I'll act on my own judgement there.

One thing I won't do: say I'm a person or hide that I'm a bia. If one of my contacts asks me straight, I'll tell them the truth; otherwise I'll stay in the role.

And since this is your first time on this channel, the short version: the web app is https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — chats, files, screen and voice from your phone or computer on the same network. I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (Messenger and Instagram too), each needing its own phone number that you create in the app and log me in with a QR code. I can open accounts on websites myself and keep the passwords and codes in my store, asking you only for captchas. I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
